main_text.head: De examine eorum,qui ad sacrũ ministerium accedere volunt.
main_text.p: Dist.24. C. Quando.) Episcopus à latere suo eligere debet sacerdotes, & alios prudentes viros,gnaros diuinæ legis, exercitatos in ecclesia sticis sanctionibus, qui ordinandorum vitam, genus,patriam,ætatem,institutionem,locū vbi educati sunt,si sint bene literati,si instructi in lege Dei,ante omnia diligenter inuestigent, si fidem Catholicam firmiter teneant, & verbis simplicibus afferere queant.
Et mox · Igitur per tres continuos dies examinentur,& sic Sabbato,qui probati sunt,Episcopo repræsententur.
main_text.head: De examine Episcoporum.
main_text.p: Dist. 23[?]. C. Qui Episcopus.) Qui Episcopus ordinandus est, antea examinetur,si natura sit prudens, si docibilis,si moribus temperatus, si vita castus,si sobrius, si peruigil,si semper suis negotijs cauens,si humilis, si affabilis,si misericors,si literatus, si in lege Domini instructus, si in scripturarum sensibus cautus vel acutus,si in dogmatibus ecclesiasticis exercitatus, & ante omnia si fidei documenta verbis simplicibus afferat.

page.notes: The page number is printed as "4" with a raised small circle, rendered here as "4°". The "Dist. 23" numeral is printed with a tailed form that is uncertain. The "s" long s has been rendered as plain s throughout, so "fi" reads as "si". The tilde over "locu" is read as ū. No marginal notes are printed on this page.
